mapper.select:
select finprod_id id,finprod_name text from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1
AND ( finprod_name LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR finprod_id LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) )

select A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, nvl(A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.finprod_name) text,A.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA on
A.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID
FINPROD_TYPE2='F16'
AND (A.finprod_id LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR A.finprod_name LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR A.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FPA.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) )

select '有效' as workStatus, tft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as tradeId,/*交易编号*/ tft.SETTLE_DATE as settleDate, /*交易日*/ fp.FINPROD_NAME as prodName,/*产品名称*/ fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as prodId,/*产品代码*/ tft.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt,/*交易金额*/ null as portfolioId,/*子组合代码*/ null as portfolioName,/*子组合名称*/ null as allotAmt, /*分配金额*/ '02' hasChildren, CONCAT(CONCAT('有效',nvl(fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,'null')),tft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID ) childInfo, 'root' parentInfo, tft.ccy ccy,
nvl(ptp.parent_portfolio_id,ptp.PORTFOLIO_ID) portfolioId1
from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tft /*金融产品汇总交易*/
LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL wdt /*金融产品交易汇总扩展*/ ON wdt.totle_trade_id=tft.totle_trade_id LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd /*金融产品交易*/ ON tft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpa /*金融产品交易附属表*/ on tpa.TRADE_ID=tpd.TRADE_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO ptp /*组合*/ on ptp.PORTFOLIO_ID=tpa.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa /*标的类金融产品附属表*/ on fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID=tft.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join (select * from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1 AND FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}
and FINPROD_MARKET_ID in (
#{item}
)
) fp /*标的类金融产品*/ on fp.FINPROD_ID=fpa.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
and tft.BUSI_TYPE=#{busiType}/*净值型TA交易*/
and tft.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2} /*业务类型.理财产品*/ and wdt.PA_BUSS_TYPE =#{paBusiType}/*平安业务类型.产品交易资金分配*/ and tft.PORTFOLIO_ID in ( select ppa.PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ppa where ppa.USER_ID=#{userId} )
and tft.SETTLE_DATE >= to_date(#{vdateStart},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and tft.SETTLE_DATE <= to_date(#{vdateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and tft.IS_CANCEL !=#{isCancel} /*是*/
group by tft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID,tft.SETTLE_DATE,fp.FINPROD_NAME,fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,tft.TRADE_AMt,tft.ccy,nvl(ptp.parent_portfolio_id,ptp.PORTFOLIO_ID)
union all select null as workStatus, null as tradeId,/*交易编号*/ null as settleDate, /*交易日*/ null as prodName,/*产品名称*/ null as prodId,/*产品代码*/ null as tradeAmt,/*交易金额*/ tpa.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId,/*子组合代码*/ ptp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName,/*子组合名称*/ decode(tpd.ps,#{ps},-1*tpd.TRADE_AMT,tpd.TRADE_AMT) as allotAmt, /*分配金额*/ '01' hasChildren, CONCAT('有效',nvl(fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,'null')) childInfo, CONCAT(CONCAT('有效',nvl(fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,'null')),tft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) parentInfo, null as ccy,
ptp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId1
from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tft /*金融产品汇总交易*/
LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL wdt /*金融产品交易汇总扩展*/ ON wdt.totle_trade_id=tft.totle_trade_id LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd /*金融产品交易*/ ON tft.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpa /*金融产品交易附属表*/ on tpa.TRADE_ID=tpd.TRADE_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO ptp /*组合*/ on ptp.PORTFOLIO_ID=tpa.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa /*标的类金融产品附属表*/ on fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID=tft.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join (select * from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1 AND FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}
and FINPROD_MARKET_ID in (
#{item}
)
) fp /*标的类金融产品*/ on fp.FINPROD_ID=fpa.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
and tft.BUSI_TYPE=#{busiType} /*净值型TA交易*/
and tft.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2} /*业务类型.理财产品*/ and wdt.PA_BUSS_TYPE =#{paBusiType}/*平安业务类型.产品交易资金分配*/ and tft.PORTFOLIO_ID in ( select ppa.PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ppa where ppa.USER_ID=#{userId} )
and tft.SETTLE_DATE >= to_date(#{vdateStart},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and tft.SETTLE_DATE <= to_date(#{vdateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and tft.IS_CANCEL !=#{isCancel} /*是*/
